insight: Aghanim's Scepter provides massive power spike in first 8 seconds of ultimate, allowing you to shred buildings and take high ground in late game.

Clinker was reworked to regain Searing Arrows. With buffs to base HP, Strafe attack speed (retroactively on skeletons), and Searing Arrows damage, the hero's win rate should improve significantly as players optimize play.
Range advantage makes her naturally resistant to harassment. Viable carry pick in patch with reduced healing and sustain items available.
3 agility gain and half armor increase benefits Time Walk survivability and heal/sustain effectiveness. Don't underestimate cumulative stat changes.
Flagbearer creep aura no longer affects heroes (was giving 180 HP over laning stage). This significantly nerfs sustain-reliant heroes in side lanes.
Healing support heroes have massive stock increase due to removal of flagbearer aura and reduced healing item sharing. Healing supports enable carry and offlane hero pools.
Liquid Fire and Liquid Frost were overpowered at level 1 (33-25% less damage on nerfs). Was dominant trump card support for laning phase.
Built-in sustain through Healing Ward made him reliable melee Battle Fury builder. Recent nerfs target this sustain advantage.
Ursa has massive sustain issues and requires a healing support to function. Pair with Warlock, Dazzle, or other healing supports to unlock carry pool.
Falcon Rush no longer works on buildings after Parkinson Vision utilized Elacrity + Falcon Rush for fast building destruction at Dream League.
Despite low win rate, Kunka is genuinely strong but underutilized due to high skill floor. Players need to learn optimal play patterns similar to Io.
Aghanim's Scepter is not viable core build because ultimate is disabled by silence and stuns, losing AoE damage in actual fights. Largo works only as support.
Bear now worth less gold in laning stage and more later. This fixes the stupid imbalance where bear was worth too much early and too little late.
Mars struggles in lane because he relies on Soul Ring without built-in sustain. Heroes with sustain or abilities reducing damage are better in this patch.
Morphling abuses sustain with high stats. Early sustain items synergize well. Can go Vlads right-click build or max Adaptive Strike with Factory Rush.
Massive buffs despite being meta for 2 years: cast range and distance on Swashbuckle, Swashbuckle damage, Shield Crash cooldown, Rolling Thunder duration/damage/magic resistance, base stats.
Try 1-1-1 stats build into Treads Yasha. Illusions hit harder with stats, duplicate faster with level 10 talent. Enables reliable CS in lane.
Basic dispel moved from level 15 to level 20 is huge nerf. Previously solved mid-game problems. One of the biggest nerfs of the patch.
Extra 6 souls late game effectively. Buffs non-magic SF builds while nerfing magic SF, making the hero random in terms of build optimization.

Saltwater Shiv cooldown reduced to 10 seconds with 12 second duration allows stacking at level 1. Can stack up to 9 HP regen by hitting repeatedly. Potential mid or safe lane dominator with phase boots.
Buffed base agility and agility gain. Try Factory on her with Shadow Step. Relies on stats for mana/health to stay on map in lane. Potential lane dominator.
Level 20 talent on Anchor Smash triggering on passive is overpowered even with 50% damage reduction. Must have Break (Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, etc.) to counter.
Aghanim's Scepter radius on Timber Chain nerfed significantly from 36 to 18 AoE (roughly halved accounting for area calculation). Still strong hero overall.
Avalanche is now status effect on ground, can't be BKBed or blocked by items. Enables chain stuns on Puck, Lifestealer, Juggernaut. Massively strengthens hero as nuker.
Buffed base armor on strength hero with heal. Nature's Guise cooldown reduced (no mana cost). Living Armor buffed. Excellent lane-securing support emerging in meta.
No longer disabled by silence when toggling stances. Big buff because you don't get stuck in bad form during fights with silences.
Level 15 talent Enraged status resistance increased to 75%. Level 20 talents more underwhelming. Prioritize Earthshock radius over Fury Swipes damage depending on game.
Heroes good at trading HP with enemy supports are strongest this patch. Warlock, Shadow Shaman, and Treant Protector are best lane-securing supports.
Range advantage and base damage buffs make her extremely unlane-able for offlaners. Pick her off-lane if available. Can max Powershot/Killshot or Shackle/Tangled depending on matchup.
